description:
Introducing the Ape Ryder Baboon—crafted for those who crave adventure and refuse to be confined to paved paths. Designed specifically for off-road and adventure enthusiasts, this e-bike combines rugged durability with advanced features to make every ride an unforgettable journey.
The 20” alloy frame is lightweight yet incredibly strong, built to withstand the toughest trails and rough terrains you encounter. With its reinforced design, the Baboon offers superior stability, making it perfect for those who love to venture off the beaten path.
Equipped with a powerful 48V 14.5Ah battery, the Baboon provides an impressive range of 65-80 km, allowing you to explore further without worrying about running out of juice. Whether you're tackling long mountain trails or cruising through the wilderness, the Baboon ensures you have the power to keep going.
The 250W motor delivers the right mix of torque and efficiency, giving you enough power to conquer steep hills while maintaining excellent energy efficiency. With a top speed of 20 mph, you can navigate both smooth and rugged terrain with ease, enjoying the thrill of the ride while staying in control.
Featuring a long comfort saddle, the Baboon ensures that even the most extended rides remain comfortable. The alloy front fork with lock-out adds to your control over the ride, letting you adjust the suspension for smooth sailing on flat roads or extra cushioning on rocky trails.
No adventure is complete without peace of mind, and the hydraulic brake system on the Baboon offers just that. With responsive stopping power, you can ride confidently knowing you have full control, even on steep descents or wet conditions.
The Kenda 20” x 4.5 tires are built to take on any surface, from loose gravel to dirt roads. With a wide tread and robust grip, they provide excellent traction and stability, ensuring a smooth ride even on the most challenging terrains.
At a net weight of 35 kg, the Baboon is light enough to handle with ease but tough enough to support a maximum rider weight of 120kg. Whether you're packing extra gear or riding solo, this e-bike is designed to carry you and everything you need for the perfect adventure.
Whether you’re exploring dense forests, crossing sandy beaches, or navigating rocky mountain trails, the Ape Ryder Baboon is your ultimate off-road partner. With its combination of power, control, and comfort, this e-bike is engineered to help you push your limits and discover new horizons.
Ride further. Ride harder. Ride with the Baboon.
